notes: Read: Costa Rica AIP Part 3 AD (DGAC), 'PARTE-3-AD-AIRAC-28-19MAY22' (MRLB pages 19 MAY 22, AIRAC AMDT 28). The AD 2.3 table prints times without a zone; AIP times are taken as UTC (Costa Rica is UTC-6) - confirm. AIP SUP 31/26 (October 2026) 'MRLB AD 2.3 Horas de Funcionamiento' changes the hours but could not be opened: https://sub.dgac.go.cr/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/sa31_26ev.pdf (permission not granted in time). So the hours above may be out of date. Heavy and medium aircraft must be towed to 30 m from taxiway Alfa entry before departure (except stand 7). Spanish source; English is a translation.
